name: Owner creates and retains a geofence
description: A signed-in owner saves a radius-based location and verifies it remains available after reloading the workspace.
steps: Add a place with valid coordinates
expected: The geofence persists with the chosen radius.

name: Invitee accepts an invitation and opts in
description: A second authenticated user joins an owner's network through an invitation code and independently enables location sharing.
steps: Invitee signs in and opens People
Invitee enters the code and accepts
expected: Sharing remains off until the invitee enables it; membership is created only for the authenticated invitee.

name: Entry and exit geofence transitions create owner alerts
description: Server-side distance checks detect a consenting invitee crossing a saved geofence and attempt to send push notifications.
steps: Invitee accepts owner invite and enables sharing
Invitee sends a coordinate inside a configured radius
Invitee sends a coordinate outside the radius
expected: Exactly one entry and one exit event are recorded for the owner, and push notifications are attempted.

name: Invitee can stop location sharing
description: An invitee revokes sharing and the backend rejects subsequent location updates.
steps: Enable sharing after accepting an invite
expected: The location endpoint rejects further updates after sharing is disabled.

name: Place picker requires a search term
description: The location chooser gives a clear validation message rather than submitting an empty place search.
expected: A visible message asks for a place name, landmark or full address and no empty search is sent.
